about_text: De-Anon is a public database of haters and violators. The project is created for transparency.
faq_a1: Use the search and filters to find the desired card. Click on a card to view detailed information.
tos_text: You agree that the information is provided as is. We are not responsible.
privacy_text: We do not collect personal data of site users. All information is public.
error_404_text: Sorry, the requested page does not exist or has been removed.
error_500_text: Something went wrong on the server. Please try again later.
manifest_subtitle: Follow the instructions for your platform – the site will work like a native app.
manifest_android_steps:
1. Open db.deanon.rf.gd in Chrome browser.
2. Tap «⋮» (menu) in the top right corner.
3. Choose «Install app» or «Add to Home screen».
4. Confirm by tapping «Install».
5. Done! The icon appears on your desktop.
manifest_ios_steps:
1. Open db.deanon.rf.gd in Safari.
2. Tap the «Share» icon (square with arrow up) at the bottom.
3. Scroll down and select «Add to Home Screen».
4. Tap «Add» in the top right corner.
5. Done! The icon appears on your home screen.
manifest_ios_screenshot_alt: [Screenshot: Safari menu with 'Add to Home Screen']
manifest_conclusion: Done! Now you have quick access to the hater database right from your phone screen. 🕵️‍♂️💚
